generations.name: First generation (electric)
generations.notes: Electric GLC on MB.EA-M, 800 V; GLC 400 4MATIC: 94 kWh usable, up to 330 kW DC, 10-80 % about 22 min. Smaller 85 kWh versions announced for Europe. EPA rates a second "(ST)" label for MY2027, meaning unclear (owner question). Confidence: medium-high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://cars.com/articles/mercedes-benz-reveals-all-new-electric-2027-glc-with-eq-technology-515371/ ; https://www.kbb.com/car-news/2027-mercedes-benz-glc-ev-nets-350-miles-costs-64950
